description: Export project traffic and behavioral insights from Microsoft Clarity.

tools.name: export-data_get-project-live-insights
tools.description: Returns aggregated metrics (sessions, page views, scroll depth, engagement, dead/rage clicks, quickbacks, script errors) for the last N days, optionally broken down by up to three dimensions. Required: numOfDays. Optional: dimension1, dimension2, dimension3.

params.name: numOfDays
params.description: Number of days to report (1 to 3).

params.name: dimension1
params.description: First breakdown dimension (e.g. Browser, Device, OS, Country, Source, Referrer, URL, Channel).
